messages.content:
Not AI/photo-style images, no — I can't generate raster art like a text-to-image model.

What I **can** do here, and it's actually part of my job in this project:

- **SVG diagrams** — hand-authored vector graphics (flowcharts, architecture diagrams, data-model maps, icons).
- **HTML mockups/dashboards** — self-contained pages using your `design/tokens.css` values (prototypes, comparisons, progress boards).
- **Pencil `.pen` designs** — via the Pencil MCP tools, for higher-fidelity UI/web/mobile design work.

Per the project setup, when a picture beats prose I create these under `crs-brain/data/docs/` and give you the clickable repo path — the app renders them inline.

I can also **read** images you point me at (screenshots, PDFs, diagrams).

What do you want to visualize? For example: the 46-module roadmap, the multi-tenant privacy-rule model, a module UI prototype, or something else.
